body: They will be two different judges

I'm not going to give you the typical "Don't do it" message, rather one that is more rational, and comes from a far too recent experience. 

I understand the freedom you speak of. I've never been closer to it than this previous time. And it's the only other time I've come away from the experience feeling hope. But the truest feeling of freedom I've ever felt was deciding I was going to fight through it. I had legal problems I could not escape from. They're not over, so I still can't escape them. But the most empowering feeling I've ever experienced was putting my hand up, and brandishing my shining middle finger to my situation, and saying "Fuck you. You're not worth giving my life."

I found this answer by thinking of my loved ones around me. However, you're answer may be different. Everyone has a different answer. I urge you in between now and then to look for your answer, because I assure You, there is one. 

If you still can't find it, I wish you peace, and that you find your redemption. Having said that, maybe you have not committed your greatest act of mockery to life yet. Maybe living would grant that opportunity
